topic: The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) has been good for the US

initialOpinions.text: I HAVE NO OPINION FOR THIS BECAUSE I HAVEN'T HEARD ABOUT IT BEFORE

It helped boost trade and lower prices for consumers but this is a black and white situation because it led to losses of jobs in certain sectors
I think it has begun to be bad for the US as too many companies are overseas now.
